playlists.name: Underrated Huge Hits
playlists.description: You may or may not know the soundtrack, but maybe you didn't give these deeper cuts the time of day they deserve. This is a curated playlist of lesser-known bangers that will take you on a journey.

playlists.name: Peace and Tranquility
playlists.description: A collection of chill tracks that I like across many games. Nice for hanging out at home.

playlists.name: All Time Faves
playlists.description: Just some of my very favourite tracks on this app in no particular order.

playlists.name: From Mii to Wii U
playlists.description: Those amazing vibes from like 2007 with the unique original Nintendo music for the Wii and 3DS. Can't recreate it.

playlists.name: Pilotwings Forever
playlists.description: The 3 Pilotwings came all have a super great, chill vibe. If you want the best of Pilotwings, you can enjoy this playlist.

playlists.name: Fight!
playlists.description: A collection of boss battle and fighting music that might be useful for your next Dungeons and Dragons game.

playlists.name: Zelda Classics
playlists.description: A collection of my favourite Zelda music across many games. Maybe not all the classics are included, it's more of a personal list of faves.

playlists.name: Peace in Hyrule
playlists.description: All the minimal piano pieces from Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom. Super chill.

playlists.name: Best Bleeps and Bloops
playlists.description: Since there are so many bleeps and bloops (chiptune music) on this app, I thought I'd collect the best ones here.

playlists.name: Fire Emblem Vibes
playlists.description: Some of the more chill tracks from Fire Emblem, although I couldn't help but put some upbeat map themes in there too because there's just so much to enjoy.

playlists.name: Paper Mario Faves
playlists.description: Specifically my favourite tracks from the Thousand Year Door.

playlists.name: Origami Faves
playlists.description: Specifically my favourite tracks from Origami King.

playlists.name: Mario Kart World Highlights
playlists.description: Listening to the entire soundtrack is exhausting, so here is a curated selection of my personal favourites.

playlists.name: Bossa Nova Bliss
playlists.description: An exhaustive collection of all the bossa nova tracks on the app.

playlists.name: The Worst of the Nintendo Music App
playlists.description: Made this for laughs but I'm the real loser because I listened to so much shitty Splatoon music to find these.
